scripts.prebuild: npm run contracts:build && npm run api-client:build
scripts.pretest: npm run contracts:build && npm run api-client:build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run browser:prepare && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.test:rust:runners: cargo test --manifest-path services/hosted-runner/Cargo.toml --no-fail-fast && cargo test --manifest-path agents/server/Cargo.toml --no-fail-fast
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix apps/docs run dev --workspaces=false
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix apps/docs run build --workspaces=false
scripts.services:build: npm run control-plane:build && npm run build --workspace @sandbox/scheduler && npm run build --workspace @sandbox/browser-worker && npm run build --workspace @sandbox/plugin-sdk
scripts.runners:build: cargo build --release --manifest-path services/hosted-runner/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --manifest-path agents/server/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run browser:build && npm run api-client:build && npm run web:build && npm run marketing:build && npm run docs:build && npm run services:build && npm run runners:build

scripts.test:all: npm run test:node && npm run test:rust && npm run test:rust:runners
